subject: Embed web page into shiny app

messages.author: e1aa1f1044f2548f
messages.subject: Embed web page into shiny app
parts:
Hi,

I've coded a shiny app, and now I'm thinking of adding a documentation. Writing the documentation in RStudio/Markdown is straightforward, but ideally, I'd like to embed the finished document as a tab into the shiny app - for instance, you could imagine that there's a tab "Instructions", which you click on to see how to use the app. Unfortunately, the documentation will also contain some equations, so simple markdown won't cut it.

Has anyone been able to accomplish something like that? I've tried "includeHTML", but my understanding is that this command is more suited for smaller chunks of HTML code, not a full webpage....

Any suggestions would be appreciated.

Many thanks, Philipp

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Embed web page into shiny app
parts: You can use includeMarkdown, and also manually inject the mathjax javascript using tags$script.
